Simple Daily Ritual

How to Use It

Moringa fits seamlessly into your existing routine. One teaspoon. One minute. Life-changing nutrition.

1
Measure your dose
Start with ½ teaspoon (2g) and build up to 1 teaspoon (4g) daily. One scoop is all you need.
2
Mix into water or juice
Stir into a glass of water, coconut water, or fresh juice. Mix well and drink immediately for best absorption.
3
Add to smoothies & food
Blend into smoothies, stir into dal, sprinkle on salads, or mix into yoghurt. Mild earthy taste blends beautifully.
4
Stay consistent
Take it every morning for best results. Most people feel the difference in energy within 2 weeks of daily use.
Pro tip: Avoid boiling moringa — heat degrades the nutrients. Always add to warm (not boiling) liquids or cool foods.
